Compare two punkst runs

Source: R/writeback.R
punkst_compare_runs.Rd

Topics have no fixed identity between fits, so each topic of a is paired with its most similar topic of b (cosine similarity of the gene loadings, over genes present in both; greedy one-to-one matching, best pairs first). When both runs use the same hexagon grid the per-hexagon top-topic assignments are also compared under that pairing.

Usage

punkst_compare_runs(a, b)

Arguments

a, b

Runs to compare: punkstRun, punkstModel, or model file paths.

Value

A list with pairs (data frame: topic_a, topic_b, cosine), similarity (full topic x topic cosine matrix), n_shared_genes, and, when the grids match, agreement (fraction of shared hexagons whose top topics are paired) and n_shared_hexagons.

Details

Works on files, so it needs no Python: give punkstRun/punkstModel objects or paths to *.model.tsv.

Examples

a <- tempfile(fileext = ".model.tsv")
b <- tempfile(fileext = ".model.tsv")
writeLines(c("gene\t0\t1", "A0\t10\t1", "B0\t1\t10"), a)
writeLines(c("gene\t0\t1", "A0\t9\t1", "B0\t1\t9"), b)
# Bare model paths have no matching *.results.tsv, so only the topic
# similarity (not the per-hexagon agreement) can be computed here.
cmp <- punkst_compare_runs(a, b)
cmp$pairs
#>   topic_a topic_b    cosine
#> 1       1       1 0.9999396
#> 2       0       0 0.9999396
